name: Sucralose
what_is: An intense synthetic sweetener made by chlorinating sucrose, about 600 times sweeter than sugar.
why_botia: It flags it because EFSA has issued warnings against extending its use due to uncertainties regarding long-term metabolic effects.
can_1: Detect E955 or Sucralose and map it to the sweetener layer.
can_2: Provide warning information regarding long-term metabolic uncertainties.
cannot_1: Determine if the sucralose was subjected to temperatures that could cause thermal degradation during cooking.
cannot_2: Calculate the precise amount of chlorinated organic compound residues from the label alone.

sources.label: EFSA re-evaluation of parabens as food additives
